title: AI Learning and Conceptual Transfer in the Game of Hidden Rules
abstract: arXiv:2608.21372v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This report summarizes the work conducted on the Game of Hidden Rules (GOHR), focusing on reinforcement learning agents trained to infer hidden rules from trial-and-error feedback, representation design, rule difficulty analysis, transfer learning, generalization, and pseudo-bot-assisted human learning analysis. The report focuses on the Transformer-based A2C framework, Feature-Centric and Object-Centric representations, experimental findings, and classification of human learning data.

translated_title: 隐藏规则游戏中的AI学习与概念迁移
translated_abstract: 本报告总结了在隐藏规则游戏（GOHR）上进行的研究工作，重点涉及通过试错反馈推断隐藏规则的强化学习智能体、表征设计、规则难度分析、迁移学习、泛化能力以及伪机器人辅助的人类学习分析。报告聚焦于基于Transformer的A2C框架、特征中心和对象中心表征、实验结果以及人类学习数据的分类。
tldr: 该论文通过Transformer-based A2C框架和多种表征设计，系统研究了AI在隐藏规则游戏中的学习与概念迁移能力，并分析了人类学习数据以验证智能体性能。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates AI learning and conceptual transfer in the Game of Hidden Rules using a Transformer-based A2C framework and various representation designs, while analyzing human learning data to validate agent performance.
